items.question: How to use ports?
items.answer: A port is a special area connecting land and sea. The owner of the port is considered to be the House that controls the land adjacent to the port. It can hold a maximum of 3 ships. The port can be used to land armies between sea and land, as well as to attack an adjacent sea or support on land and sea.

items.question: What is the optimal strategy?
items.answer: The optimal strategy depends on your playstyle and the current game state.

items.question: How to hire troops?
items.answer: Troops can be hired in any area that has a CASTLE or STRONGHOLD. STRONGHOLD = 2 muster points, CASTLE = 1 muster point. These points only work in the area where the corresponding structure is located! Footman = 1 pt, Knight = 2 pts, Ship = 1 pt, Siege Engine = 2 pts. Upgrading a footman unit to a knight OR siege engine = 1 pt.

items.question: What does the Messenger Raven do?
items.answer: The raven during the order reveal phase (AND ONLY THEN) allows you to look at a card from the Wildling deck. OR you can replace one of YOUR orders on the table with an order from the RESERVE. This allows you to better plan your actions.
